OnRegisterDatabase()

SFDatabases are registered by the DatabaseRegistry which is loaded during the player start up as part of the preloaded assets set in the project's PlayerSettings via SetPreloadedAssets. So there OnEnable runs when the runtime player starts and is guaranteed to run before anything scene related.
